company.name: State Bank of India
company.summary: Deposits, lending, payments and financial services delivered across a broad customer network.
company.description: State Bank of India provides personal, business, agricultural, corporate and international banking. Its website also connects customers to digital services such as YONO.
products: Agriculture and Kisan Credit Card loans
company.money: SBI earns interest on loans and investments, pays for deposits and other funding, and earns fees. Credit quality, operating costs and the economics of subsidiaries also affect consolidated results.
company.ownership: This profile covers State Bank of India. SBI Life, SBI Cards, SBI Mutual Fund and other SBI-named businesses have distinct legal and ownership structures; owning SBI shares is not identical to directly owning each one.
watch: Are lending and funding expanding together?
How are bad loans and provisions changing?
Does the bank have enough capital for its risks and growth?
risks: Economic stress can increase borrower defaults.
Rates affect funding costs, loan yields and investment values.
A large network requires strong technology, service and risk controls.
update: A familiar name covers several legal entities
SBI’s official page identifies subsidiaries in insurance, cards and asset management. Check which results are consolidated into the bank.
company.question: Does an SBI-branded credit card automatically mean the card company is wholly owned by SBI?
company.answer: No. Brand relationships and legal ownership are separate questions. Check the listed entity and current shareholding.
company.productNote: Major official brand, product and business-offering families reviewed in October 2026. This groups variants, pack sizes, models, formulations or service subtypes where listing each one would obscure the company overview.
